name: Clank! In! Space!: A Deck-Building Adventure

categories.label: Escaped by pod, or knocked out in Cargo Bay holding an Artifact
categories.labelVi: Thoát bằng pod, hoặc gục tại Cargo Bay khi có cổ vật
categories.hint: Tick only if you reached an escape pod, or were knocked out in the Cargo Bay carrying an Artifact. Others cannot score and cannot win.

categories.label: Credits
categories.hint: 1 VP per Credit; include 5- and 2-Credit chips if kept

categories.label: Points on cards in deck
categories.hint: Sum of the number in each card's top-right corner

categories.label: Escape pod token
categories.hint: +20 if you reached an escape pod with an Artifact

categories.label: Sixth Crystal: total Power Crystals owned
categories.hint: If you hold the Sixth Crystal token, enter your total Power Crystals including the token (3 VP each); otherwise 0

categories.label: Market items kept
categories.hint: Master Key 5, TelePass 5, Med Kit 5, Contraband 10 VP each

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the most valuable Artifact wins

notes: family: engine-tableau (deckbuilder race). Game ends when every player has escaped or been knocked out. Only players who reached an escape pod or at least the Cargo Bay (with an Artifact) count their score. Token values (Spaceship Plans 7, Archive 3, Sixth Crystal 3 per crystal, Market items 5/5/5/10) read from the rulebook token reference (p.12). Expansion/scenario tokens and card values vary and are scorer inputs. Base-game rulebook; Renegade Games English edition.
